notes.title: Modern farming!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Daomei Villagers! 🌾[/b][/h2]

[h3]Welcome to another devlog from our beloved Daomei Village! Today, we're going to talk about new, exciting farming possibilities we're introducing to the game. We know that crops are crucial – after all, we need to pay the tax collector, right? 💸 But don’t worry, we have some cool updates that will make growing plants even more fun and efficient![/h3]

In previous devlogs, we talked about classic f[b]arming – watering with a can, growing outdoors, and so on. Now it's time for something extra!
[/b]


[h3][b]🔧 AUTOMATIC WATERING[/b][/h3]
Don't feel like running around with a watering can? We’ve got you covered! You can now invest in automatic watering systems. Available in three sizes: 3x3, 5x5, and 7x7. You can craft them in the workshop using resources. Once set up, your plants will be watered regularly without any effort from you! 🌱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/848e56f87bb57428e019b365591bd14b5988f993.png[/img]


[h3][b]🌿 GREENHOUSES[/b][/h3]
Want to protect your crops from unpredictable weather and pests? Introduce greenhouses! Here too, you have three sizes to choose from: 3x3, 5x5, and 7x7, crafted in the workshop. Greenhouses provide 100% protection from the wind and reduce the chances of diseases and pests by 50%. 🌦️🦗

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/5f1dae24ebbc7821f14db9da966d9ba81d8308ac.png[/img]


[h3][b]🔄 COMBINE AND CONQUER[/b][/h3]
And the best part? You can combine automatic watering and greenhouses on a single plot! Maximum protection with minimal effort. The perfect combination for any farmer looking to optimize their harvests and focus on other aspects of life in Daomei Village. 🌟


[h3]
We can't wait for you to see these new features in action! Let us know what you think and what other features you’d like to see in the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us![/h3]

Thanks for being with us and have a great time in Daomei Village! 🌾❤️


[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/0d8767188c38fa90082f359aff504adfbe0d7345.png[/img][/url]



See you soon,
The Daomei Village Team

notes.title: Houses
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We recall you’ve not had an opportunity to visit your future neighbors- the lovely habitants of Daomei Village at their homes. Today, it’s time to change that! We’re happy to invite you for a tour around their places. 🏠

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/8308ed8746eb5529d2aa5929c413c4b1936f9ab7.png[/img]
As we’ve previously mentioned, throughout your gameplay[b] you’ll have access to most of the houses[/b], being able to come in during the day. Inside, there are objects you’ll be able to interact with, such as beds, kitchen stove or crafting stations like tea drying station or alchemy table. 👐 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/f9e70d16d8644e26db115c1438789e5f917f002b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/6cb6d1ef8e602af8f1e0cf82f7302ef7c676b0b4.png[/img]
As you can see, every villager has their own style of the house with different pieces of furniture, colors etc. [b]You’ll also be able to give your own house a twist with customizable decorations, floors and furniture! [/b]🤩 We can’t wait to see how you decorate your own places! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/9f22b5bc94d2fe9d567db65b0e01b2416f339789.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/1dc8c2ba15b650dbc2d8489ede75ad0bd3e67b4b.png[/img]
[b]Don’t forget to sign up for the upcoming Playtest which is soon to begin![/b] 👍 To do it you can visit the game’s main page on Steam and press the green button [b]“Request Access”[/b]. We also encourage you to[b] join our discord[/b] community to meet other people interested in our Daomei Village! 🌾

[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/fa82d0aea3703f175dee3fbc12eb4d8ca80416e4.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825030/Daomei_Village/ 

See you soon,
Daomei Village Team

notes.title: Day and night
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Fellow Villagers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to our humble Daomei Village. We’re happy to see you back after a while and today we’d like to talk about an important part of the daily activities of everyone around here. Today, we’ll talk about [b]☀️day & night🌑 cycle[/b]!

[previewyoutube=c4jYX1saBI8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]In our village, different opportunities and possibilities come at different times but they also impose certain rules we’d like you to follow. With that being said, let’s give you some examples! 📝[/h3]

[b]During the day, you’ll be able to complete quests and assignments, craft items, explore the areas relatively safely or focus on the agricultural aspect of the gameplay[/b]. Every evening though, you’ll be expected to come back to your hut for the night. 🛌

You’ll be able to come back by yourself after finishing your duties or get forcefully moved once you reach a certain hour outside. ⌚

[b]In the evenings you’ll be able to find some extraordinary items you wouldn’t be able to come across during the day like different species of bugs and mushrooms. 🍄[/b] So make sure to look out for them during your nightly escapades. 

[h3]We’ve also prepared many items which could come in handy to save some time like the potions of quickness. ⚗️ You should definitely think of using them to get the most value out of every single night! 💪[/h3]

[b]Every morning you’ll receive a summary of the previous day as well as some information: current weather, crop damages etc.[/b]

That’s it for to… Oh wait… 😢 Sometimes the tax collector will also appear in the morning. Maybe not opening the door or getting yourself a bigger dog will make him skip your farm. 🤔

With this positive accent we can end today’s short devlog. [b]Don’t forget to join our discord and if you’d like to support us, make sure to add this game to your Steam wishlist! [/b]❤️‍

[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/fa82d0aea3703f175dee3fbc12eb4d8ca80416e4.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825030/Daomei_Village/ 

See you soon,
Daomei Village Team

notes.title: Map
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Daomei Enjoyers! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re glad to see you again in another devlog from our lovely village! 💝 [b]Currently, we’re working hard to put the finishing touches on the village construction![/b] Thus far, we’ve completed all the housing areas, tavern and utility buildings such as smithy ⚒️ and florist shop. 🌼

[h3]On top of that, we’ve implemented interactions with every habitant of the Daomei Village. 👍 We strongly emphasize the importance of interactions with all the villagers as they often take active part in the quests both as a supporting character and an employer![/h3]

In the short video we’d like to present to you at the end of this devlog we’re showcasing the map we’ve created along the characters deployed in (most likely) their final positions. We’re also showcasing some dialogs between the player and villagers which you can start by pressing the interaction key “F”. We’d also like to remind you we’re still trying to find the best possible colors for the game so the final colors may be different. 📝

Each villager will have his assigned position on the map, so finding them should not give you any problems!

[previewyoutube=p9PaAiPOdLg;full][/previewyoutube]

Speaking of the map, we are really curious if you’d like to have the possibility to put markers on the map to be able to easily find areas/points on the map you deem important… Please let us know in the comments! 🔥[b] If you’d like to have some map functionality, suggestion about map’s look or features please don’t hesitate to share your ideas with us on our discord. 👇[/b] You can also add the game to your Steam Wishlists to get notified about any update!

[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/fa82d0aea3703f175dee3fbc12eb4d8ca80416e4.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825030/Daomei_Village/

See you soon,
Daomei Village Team

notes.title: New Discord Server!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋 [/b][/h1]

[h2]We are back to you after a rather long break since the latest news related to [b]Daomei Village [/b]🕰️[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/f93736b7a6b26c69f15075804487ad6cc8cad8b3.png[/img]


[h2]We realize that this break was overly long - and you were worried about our absence and lack of any information, relating to the progress related to our game 💔[/h2]

[h2]We thank you from the bottom of our hearts, for all the messages full of support, and [b]we assure you that we have not abandoned work on our game![/b] 👏[/h2]

[b]After all this time, we are back with full force 💪 From now on, there will be regular posts every month - devlogs that you know well 📅 As before, they will introduce you to the development steps - main tasks and also the operation of individual (most interesting) mechanics! [/b]

Now we would like to announce that [b]we are changing the location of our Discord server[/b] 🔔 Up until now, you have been able to contact us through the Daomei Village server, but [b]we are moving to a brand new server full of diverse players, which we are running together with our friends Games Incubator.[/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/6d7d9f7e31a936b2efce67288527fdb21f3807b8.png[/img]


[h2][b]You are very welcome to join us and we assure you that it is worth it! 👇[/b][/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41839711/0d8767188c38fa90082f359aff504adfbe0d7345.png[/img][/url]


We hope that you will continue our journey with us, the finale of which will be during the release of the full version of Daomei Village, and then together we will rebuild the title village and return to the Emperor's good graces! 🏮


[h2][b]If you want to receive all the information about the production as soon as possible, then we encourage you to add Daomei Village, to your Wishlist! [/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825030/Daomei_Village/


See You soon,
Daomei Village Team

notes.title: CUSTOMIZATION
notes.content:
[h2]WELCOME! ⛩️[/h2]

Today we would like to show you how the game is developed and what cool features are waiting for you. We are going to slowly reveal to you the most interesting aspects of our project to whet your appetite 😊

Today we will focus on the possibility of customizing our character. At Daomei Village, we want to give you the opportunity to completely empathize with the character.  Thanks to character customization, the gameplay will be much more pleasant for you, and the various stories of our NPCs will trigger positive emotions.

To achieve this, we decided to enrich the game with UI that allows you to change many aspects of our protagonist: change the color of the hair, body or eyes, but also change details such as clothes!
[previewyoutube=pNUsPNmYVdM;full][/previewyoutube]
At your disposal there will be colorful caps, hairstyles, shirts and pants kept in mainly Chinese style.

As always, we are open to all your suggestions, if you want to contact us directly, you can do it on a dedicated Discord server, also you can find [b]exclusive content[/b] there and know about the latest information in advance 😎 Just click the link below 👇
[url=https://discord.gg/ujMc55FHqY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39325127/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

IF YOU WANT TO BE UP TO DATE WITH GAME DEVELOPMENT, ADD IT TO YOUR [b]STEAM WISHLIST[/b] and PRESS [b]FOLLOW[/b] BUTTON 😊
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825030/Daomei_Village/

We are going back to work, see you soon! 
Daomei Village Team
